test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Our neighbour told my brother __to keep an eye on__ their pet dog in their absence.

options.text: To look after something or someone
To wait for something that is disturbing

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To look after something or someone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"look after"** means to take care of someone or something; to ensure that someone or something is safe and well. (देखभाल करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She has to look after her younger brother while their parents are away.
 
 
 
• **"Keep an eye on"** means to watch over someone or something to make sure they are safe and not in trouble. (नज़र रखना)
 
 
• **Example: **Can you keep an eye on my bag while I go to the restroom?
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that "keep an eye on" is synonymous with "look after."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To look after something or someone.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: To accomplish something too ambitious** (कुछ बहुत महत्वाकांक्षी हासिल करना): Refers to attempting to achieve something that is very difficult or unlikely.

 
 
• **Example:** Trying to finish this project in one day is too ambitious.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To wait for something that is disturbing** (कुछ परेशान करने वाली चीज़ का इंतजार करना): Refers to being in a state of anticipation for something troubling.
 
 
• **Example:** Waiting for the results of the test was very disturbing.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To ignore something or someone** (किसी चीज या किसी को नज़रअंदाज़ करना): Refers to deliberately not paying attention to something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** He chose to ignore the comments about his performance.
 
 

183:Td3b,

The correct answer is 'Option 2'.
